steps.content: [Scene Change] Farland Secret Hideout, Some WhiteSands Underground Ruins
Several advisors sit around a battered table, the air heavy with the scent of sun-baked sand, cold metal, and ancient bones—
—underpinned by the unmistakable tang of anxiety.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: Why would they push into the storm? Are they tracking the Black Ring? Who gave up our position?

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: Damn it! That Underground woman Moore swore DisCity's network out here was ashes. So how did the enemy find out our location?

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor B
steps.content: I don't think it was a leak. It's something else.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor B
steps.content: Scouts report DisCity's Shepherd is awake. Yesterday's fight sent a pulse through BR-005. It resonated with the Shepherd through those "shackles." Once that connection is made, Shepherd can just... feel where the Ring is.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: Sense it through the shackles...? You don't mean—

Shortly after the Black Ring outbreak over a month ago, the Aurum Secretum Institute deployed several miniature monitoring devices into the Ring through its fusion with the Apostles. Several attached themselves to Sinner Hella, providing them with critical data on the Black Ring's internal conditions.
Now, those same devices are transmitting erratic, heavily corrupted readings.
[Scene Change] Beneath the Black Ring

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: That B-Class Sinner, Hella... The shackles have pierced into our Black Ring through her. They're still digging right now, trying to pinpoint it. It's only a matter of time before the enemy plows through the Tide of Ashes and finds us.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: Tch. A worthless B-Class. Negligible power, and yet she keeps gutting our most critical experiments... She needs to be removed. Permanently.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: The Aurum Secretum devices planted in the Black Ring... we can use them to lock onto her and force a full resonance. It won't just stop the signal; it'll turn her into a complete Corruptor. We plug the leak and maybe contaminate the shackles' user in the process... Yeah, that'll be it!
He finishes his calculations in a flash and rushes to the Aurum Secretum device, feeding the data into its core.
The red engravings at its center flare with blinding intensity. In response, a viscous, pitch-black Mania gel begins to ooze from the device—a sure sign the sorcery has taken hold.

The man can barely contain his triumph. He barks orders at several Sinners to guide the Aurum Secretum operation using the techniques taught by the Underground. But as he watches the Mania flow and the first data from within BR-005 flicker to life...

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: Ah... Ahh... AAAAHHHHH!!!
As if obeying another command, the gel halts. It then recoils violently, expanding backward and lashing out with whip-like tentacles that ensnare the advisor in a crushing embrace.
The man is engulfed in an instant. His skin blisters and sloughs away, his body contorting and withering as a horrific stench—the very smell of death—fills the air.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor A
steps.content: No, no, please!!! Help, HELP!!!

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor B
steps.content: What the hell is going on? Why is the Black Ring attacking us?? Could that DisCity Sinner have taken control of the Black Ring?

Off to the side, Synex munches on oleaster berries as she enjoys the show. These self-important Fraser intellectuals are a riot. One moment they're condemning Little Hella with mounting arrogance, the next they're trembling in fear. Scheming her way into this assignment has been well worth the trouble.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: ...Fools. The arrogance, to think they could ever wield the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: These are the ones who chose death over bending a knee to you. Their final act, paid for in blood. You can dump all the Aurum Secretum you want into this. Some things are just beyond your grasp.
She lifts her gaze to the points of light swirling within the Black Ring. Her close resonance with Mania allows her a faint glimpse of the chaos within.
The churning contamination outlines Hella's frail figure at its core. The girl is neither powerful enough to master the Black Ring nor has she been consumed by it—she exists in a precarious stasis.
Within the frenzy, there's something else lurking: chaotic wills. They coil gently around the girl, a paradoxical force both protecting and corrupting her, holding her in a delicate balance.
What's protecting her are other "people"—those departed souls.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You see, but you don't understand... This Black Ring will never allow anyone to lay a finger on her.
She is smugly chewing another berry when someone brushes past behind her, their robe whispering against her tail. Synex jolts with a shiver.
A relatively young officer enters the barracks. He isn't from the Campbell family, but she recalls seeing him alongside someone...

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: If the Black Ring wants her, so be it. Adelaide always said to respect wills beyond our understanding.
Young, yet surprisingly resolute. Then it clicks. Adelaide's lackey.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: But against our true enemy, the Black Ring and we are not opposed. Synex, get the advisors back to camp.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Yes... sir—
She maintains a facade of courteous respect until the very moment she departs, keenly aware of the young officer's gaze. She must leave now; a moment longer, and he would surely see through her.
Only once Synex has vanished from sight does the young Fraser officer turn to consider the truly crucial person.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: As for those tracking shackles... I'll find a way to deal with them...
